Check control or standard rows against the contract before writing them

Source: R/point_estimates_contract.R
validate_point_estimates.Rd

Verifies that a data frame destined for calib_controls or calib_standards contains no column the contract does not know, has every key and non-nullable column filled, and that the controlled vocabularies (exclusion_reason, pcov_gate_class, censor_class, censor_type) hold only allowed values. Stops with a message listing the problems, so a bad batch is caught before it reaches the database. created_at is filled by the database and may be absent.

Usage

validate_point_estimates(
  x,
  table = c("controls", "standards", "control_reference")
)

Arguments

x

Data frame of rows to be written. For control_reference, the generated reference_id and the defaulted assigned_at, valid_from, study_accession, control_lot and feature may be absent.

table

"controls", "standards" or "control_reference".

Value

x, invisibly, if it conforms.

See also

point_estimates_contract()
